expanded_end_time_str = "2020-04-11 06:00:00"
expanded_start_time = tz.localize(pd.to_datetime(expanded_start_time_str))
expanded_end_time = tz.localize(pd.to_datetime(expanded_end_time_str))

# Filter node_container_service_metrics_df for expanded time window
expanded_filtered_metrics_df = node_container_service_metrics_df[
    (node_container_service_metrics_df['datetime'] >= expanded_start_time) &

].copy()

# Calculate global P5 thresholds for each component-KPI time series (reuse thresholds_df for P95)
if not node_container_service_metrics_df.empty:
    p5_thresholds_df = node_container_service_metrics_df.groupby(['cmdb_id', 'name'])['value'].quantile(0.05).reset_index()
    p5_thresholds_df.rename(columns={'value': 'p5_threshold'}, inplace=True)
